choices.content: The boundary point may correspond to two values
The function must be undefined at the boundary point
The formulas for the two pieces must be identical
Which piece applies at this point and whether the function value is unique

question.prompt: What needs particular attention at a boundary point of a piecewise function?

solutions.explanation: Check the endpoint conditions to determine which pieces apply. A boundary point in the domain must have a unique function value; if two pieces include it, their formulas must agree there. Therefore the answer is D.
solutions.title: Check endpoint conditions
